findings.what: verify_skills.py raises FileNotFoundError on check_readme_links_exist when the skill tree is vendored without the pack README
findings.why: Landing checks assume SKILLS_DIR.parent is the GitHub pack root. A sibling-only standalone port has no README there. check_readme_docs_contract fails softly, then check_readme_links_exist reads the missing file and aborts the remaining registry.

scenario.trigger: Copy qc-core plus specializations into an agent skills directory (documented standalone port), then run python3 qc-core/scripts/verify_skills.py
scenario.violated_invariant: Skill-tree verification completes every registry check; missing pack landing files skip landing checks instead of raising
scenario.observable: FileNotFoundError for <parent>/README.md; process exits 1; later checks including core_self_test never run

findings.fix: Detect pack checkout (README.md + docs/qc-core.pdf). Skip landing checks otherwise. Never read README without exists().

findings.what: suite_rollup.py raised JSONDecodeError on a truncated ledger; verify_ledger.py reports FAIL on the same input
findings.fix: Catch OSError/ValueError on ledger and skipped-list reads; print FAIL and exit 1

findings.what: ruff F601 repeated dict key 'fixed' in a discarded setup object; F841 unused ts_groups
findings.fix: Remove the dead dict and unused assignment

findings.what: After suite_rollup fail-closed on bad JSON, the same json.loads pattern still traceback'd in render_profile, verify_port, partition, and write_ledger
findings.why: Pass 3 fixed one CLI. The other ingest paths still assumed well-formed JSON.

scenario.trigger: Feed truncated JSON to render_profile.py, verify_port.py --expected, partition.py --profile, or write_ledger.py <src.json> after suite_rollup already fail-closes on the same class of input
scenario.violated_invariant: Every JSON ingest CLI fail-closes with FAIL and exit 1; none traceback
scenario.observable: JSONDecodeError (and on partition, NameError: sys) on stderr; dest files may be untouched or the process aborts mid-registry

findings.fix: Catch OSError/ValueError on those CLIs; import sys in partition.py; chaos tests assert no Traceback

findings.what: partition.py --reexam --profile <truncated.json> raised NameError: sys is not defined while handling JSONDecodeError
findings.why: The fail-closed print used sys.stderr but partition.py did not import sys.

scenario.trigger: Write truncated JSON to a profile file and run partition.py --reexam --profile on it (production-shaped: operator passes a half-written .qc-profile.json)
scenario.violated_invariant: Error handlers do not introduce a second exception; fail-closed uses imported names only
scenario.observable: Traceback chaining JSONDecodeError into NameError; exit 1 without the FAIL: unreadable profile line completing

findings.fix: import sys; chaos test covers partition.py --profile bad.json

examined.invariant: compute_verdict is the only verdict algorithm; presence P0 blocks even when fixed; atomic_write_json uses temp+fsync+replace so readers never see a partial ledger
Landing-doc checks run only on the GitHub pack checkout; a vendored sibling layout skips them and still completes skill-contract checks
reexam_set is changed files plus import-graph neighbors that already sit in hot_spots or pass_debt; language boundaries never mix in one group
write_ledger.py delegates to qc.atomic_write_json; dest parent is created; JSON is the full object not a patch
suite_verdict is computed from per-skill ledgers via qc.suite_verdict; missing non-skipped ledgers fail closed
Secret-bearing filenames (.env, *.pem, *.key) are gitignored; planted fixture secrets stay in skills/qc-core/fixtures/
Unreadable or non-JSON ledgers fail closed with FAIL on stderr and exit 1; they do not traceback
test_core.py is ruff-clean; suite algebra fixtures do not rely on duplicate dict keys
Unreadable profile JSON prints FAIL and exits 1; markdown is not written
Unreadable expected/ledger/profile prints FAIL and exits 1
Unreadable --profile JSON prints FAIL on stderr and exits 1 without NameError
Unreadable stdin or src JSON prints FAIL and does not replace dest
